newsitem.title: USA: Chicago Dock gets unsolicited offer.
newsitem.headline: Chicago Dock gets unsolicited offer.

text.p: Chicago Dock & Canal Trust said Friday it received an unsolicited proposal from Cityfront Center LLC, which is seeking to acquire Chicago Dock for $22 a share in cash.
Chicago Dock has previously agreed to a $21 a share acquisition offer from Newsweb Corp and CDCT Acquisition Trust, an affiliate of Newsweb.
Chicago Dock had set January 9 as the special meeting date for the proposed merger with Newsweb.

Cityfront, an affiliate of MCL Chicago Homes Inc, said it intends to make an offer that is nearly identical to the agreement with Newsweb and CDCT, Chicago Dock said. Cityfront, however, is bidding $1.00 a share more for Chicago Dock, which is a real estate investment trust.
Chicago Dock said it will seek to meet with representatives of Cityfront regarding its proposal.
Under the merger agreement with Newsweb, Chicago Dock has the right, in certain circumstances, to approve or recommend a better proposal, or to terminate the merger agreement with Newsweb.
Chicago Dock said any action it takes is subject to compliance with provisions of the merger agreement with Newsweb.
